messages:
Maya Singh (AE): We received an RFI from BrightForge. They want a capability matrix plus a short line for HSM/KMS support and 2-week POC pricing (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Can eng/security help?

Owen Lee (SSE): Happy to. Do we know target context length and qps?

Maya Singh (AE): Their initial asks: 100 concurrent streams, 20k embeddings/day, mostly 16k context. EU data residency required.

Marco Rossi (Eng): Draft matrix for RFI table. Need latency sanity checks.

Marco Rossi (Eng): ```
Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated (small) | Private (VPC/HSM)
--- | --- | --- | ---
Context len | up to 32k | up to 32k | up to 32k
Gen p50 (16k) | 130-200 ms | 85-130 ms | 95-145 ms
Gen p95 (16k) | 500-800 ms | 300-480 ms | 320-520 ms
Embed p50 | 35-70 ms | 18-40 ms | 20-45 ms
Concurrency | bursty | reserved 100-300 | configurable
KMS/HSM | Redwood KMS | customer KMS | HSM add-on supported
SLA | standard | SLA-backed | enterprise SLA
```

Priya Nair (Security): HSM phrasing: "We support customer HSMs and HSM-backed KMS for Private deployments. Redwood never receives plaintext keys; attestation/reporting available under NDA." Legal needs to sign off.

Owen Lee (SSE): POC estimates: hosted 2-week unoptimized $18k, optimized $7k; dedicated small pool 2-week $28k; private + HSM 2-week $48k + integration. I'll confirm with finance.

Maya Singh (AE): Please post final bundle by 2pm tomorrow so I can review and send.

attach-bot: Uploaded: brightforge_rfi_docs_v1.zip :paperclip:

Marco Rossi (Eng): Will do latency paragraph and ops note about fallback + quantization by noon.

Priya Nair (Security): Adding note: logs retention default 30 days, configurable; region pinning supported for Dedicated/Private.

Owen Lee (SSE): I'll assemble.
